# Carregando os pacotes

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(phangorn)
```

# Diretórios

```{r}
BASE_DIR <- getwd()
PHYLOGENY_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "PHYLOGENY")
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "FIGURES")
MATRIX_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "RESULTS", "MATRIX")
```

# Importando a árvore filogenética

```{r}
# Árvore filogenética:
TREE_FILE <- file.path(PHYLOGENY_DIR, "viral_phylogeny.treefile")
tree <- read.tree(TREE_FILE)

# Número de sequências:
Ntip(tree)

# Número de nós internos:
Nnode(tree)

# Identificadores das sequências:
tree$tip.label
```

# Importando os metadados das sequências

```{r}
# Metadados:
metadata = read_xlsx("metadata.xlsx")

# Sequências presentes na árvore:
tree_sequences <- tree$tip.label

# Sequências presentes nos metadados:
metadata_sequences <- metadata$Sequence

# Sequências sem metadados:
setdiff(tree_sequences, metadata_sequences)

# Metadados sem sequência na árvore:
setdiff(metadata_sequences, tree_sequences)
```

# Árvore filogenética (Maximum Likelihood)

```{r}
# Árvore básica:
p1 <- ggtree(tree) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = !isTip, label = label),
    size = 2.5, hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5)
print(p1)

# Integrando árvore e metadados:
p2 <- ggtree(tree) %<+% metadata + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Genotype, shape = Host), size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = label), size = 3, linesize = 0.3) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = !isTip, label = label),
    size = 2.5, hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p2)

# Destacando sequências por hospedeiro:
p3 <- ggtree(tree) %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Host), size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = !isTip, label = label),
    size = 2.5, hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p3)

# Árvore circular:
p4 <- ggtree(tree, layout = "circular") %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Genotype, shape = Host), size = 2) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = label), size = 3, offset = 0.01) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p4)

# Opção enraizada:
tree_rooted <- phangorn::midpoint(tree)
p_rooted <- ggtree(tree_rooted) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  geom_text2(aes(subset = !isTip, label = label),
    size = 2.5, hjust = 1.2,vjust = -0.5)
print(p_rooted)
```

# Calculando as distâncias genéticas

```{r}
# Importando o alinhamento:
ALIGNMENT_FILE <- file.path(PHYLOGENY_DIR, "viral_sequences_aligned.aliview.fasta")
alignment <- read.dna(ALIGNMENT_FILE,format = "fasta")

# Calculando distâncias genéticas:
genetic_distance <- dist.dna(
  alignment,
  model = "raw",
  pairwise.deletion = TRUE)

# Convertendo para matriz:
genetic_distance_matrix <- as.matrix(genetic_distance)

# Alterando os nomes das linhas:
rownames(genetic_distance_matrix) = metadata$Sequence

# Alterando os nomes das colunas
colnames(genetic_distance_matrix) = metadata$Sequence

# Organizar metadata de acordo com a matriz:
metadata_heatmap <- metadata[match(rownames(genetic_distance_matrix), 
                                   metadata$Sequence),]

# Conferir correspondência:
stopifnot(all(rownames(genetic_distance_matrix) == metadata_heatmap$Sequence))

# Definir nomes das linhas:
rownames(metadata_heatmap) <- metadata_heatmap$Sequence

# Definir cores das anotações:
annotation_colors <- list(
  Genotype = c("G1" = "#1F78B4", "G3" = "#33A02C", "G4" = "#FF7F00", "G40" = "#6A3D9A", 
               "G9" = "#E31A1C", "G10" = "#FB9A99"),
  Host = c("Homo sapiens" = "#4D4D4D", "Vaccine strain" = "#E31A1C", "Jungle crow" = "#33A02C"))

# Definir cores das escalas:
col = colorRamp2(
  c(min(genetic_distance_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(range(genetic_distance_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max(genetic_distance_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("#3F7B90", "#FFFFFF", "#BC5943"))

# Anotação das colunas:
column_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Genotype = metadata_heatmap$Genotype,
  Host = metadata_heatmap$Host,
  col = annotation_colors,
  show_legend = TRUE)

# Criar heatmap:
p_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  genetic_distance_matrix,
  name = "Genetic distance",
  col = col,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  top_annotation = column_annotation,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.text(
      sprintf("%.3f", genetic_distance_matrix[i, j]),
      x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    )
  },
  border = FALSE)

# Visualizar:
p_heatmap
```

# Árvore filogenética (Neighbor-Joining)

```{r}
# Neighbor-Joining:
tree_nj <- nj(genetic_distance_matrix)

# Árvore básica:
p1_nj <- ggtree(tree_nj) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3)
print(p1_nj)

# Integrando árvore e metadados:
p2_nj <- ggtree(tree_nj) %<+% metadata + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Genotype, shape = Host), size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = label), size = 3, linesize = 0.3) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p2_nj)

# Destacando sequências por hospedeiro:
p3_nj <- ggtree(tree_nj) %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Host),size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p3_nj)

# Árvore circular:
p4_nj <- ggtree(tree_nj, layout = "circular") %<+% metadata +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = Genotype, shape = Host), size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = label), size = 3, offset = 0.01) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
print(p4_nj)
```

# Salvando os arquivos

```{r}
# Árvores:
ggsave(filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "viral_phylogenetic_tree.pdf"), 
       plot = p2, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "viral_phylogenetic_tree_circular.pdf"), 
       plot = p4, width = 12, height = 12)

# Heatmap:
ggsave(filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "heatmap_genetic_distance.pdf"), 
       plot = p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 12)

# Matriz de distâncias genéticas:
write.xlsx(genetic_distance_matrix, 
           file.path(MATRIX_DIR,"genetic_distance_matrix.xlsx"), 
           rowNames = TRUE)
```
